title: First Steps
subtitle: The exact entry sequence
text: Take two Hemolytic Solutions from the church supply. At the Unstained Podium, use one solution to suppress the infection. Craft the second solution with stone to make four Cleansed Stone. Use that stone and Lethean Poppies to build Lethean Baptism. Hold the Cardinal Rite Staff and right-click the completed rite to invoke it. The rite begins Purity only after the Podium has suppressed your infection.
